438255534.body: ps5 mihawkos-v8.2.0-alpha-8 mihawkos is a passion project, not a piracy project it exists so you can play the games you own on the console you own piracy is not condoned no games, saves, keys, firmware or exploits are included, and they never will be use only games and programs you have the right to run : your own copies, bought or installed by you requests for, or links to, games, keys, firmware or exploits are not welcome in this project s issues or discussions a new look for the desktop: settings, dialogs and text as they were designed, and every shortcut with its own icon a point release of alpha 8, all about the mihawkos desktop. it is still experimental. mihawkos offers this update by itself from alpha 8.1, alpha 8 and 7.1 what s new: a new settings : home, personalization and display as designed, with a wallpaper picker what s new: smoother text : softer, cleaner letters everywhere on the desktop what s new: the right icon on every shortcut : no more wine icons on your desktop what s new: dialogs, colours and windows : light dialogs, your theme s accent colour, calmer inactive windows what s new: create shortcut works : from file explorer and the desktop, plus pin to start what s new: steam sign-in fixed : a new steam install no longer stays on steam is updating itself a new settings home, personalization and system display are redrawn as the design draws them pick your wallpaper in personalization: bubble city by skeuoss, mihawkos s own bubble earth, glass city and aqua world, and the theme wallpapers. the desktop changes as soon as you pick one quick settings is drawn as designed too smoother text letters are now drawn with 256 shades of grey instead of 17, with light hinting, so their edges are smooth on a tv no colour fringes the right icon on every shortcut every desktop shortcut now shows its own icon: the one the shortcut names, or else its program s own, found inside your mihawkos setup. store shortcuts and launchers that used to show wine s icon now show theirs. on the test console, 31 of 31 shortcuts show the right icon, for 64-bit and 32-bit programs alike dialogs, colours and windows message boxes and task dialogs stay light in the dark theme, as designed, and use the desktop s own font. programs that asked for the segoe ui font used to get a serif one your theme s accent colour is used in settings, start, the calendar, file explorer and the taskbar inactive windows get a calm, solid title bar, as in the design mihawkos, not windows: the desktop s prompts and messages say mihawkos create shortcut works create shortcut and pin to start work from file explorer and from the desktop s menu. the old create link item that did nothing is gone a new shortcut appears on the desktop within about a tenth of a second, and a deleted one is gone within half a second a start pin no longer shows up as a phantom icon on the desktop steam sign-in fixed in 8.1, a new steam install could stay on steam is updating itself for ten minutes and then ask to try again, every time issue 62 . steam had finished; mihawkos just never noticed that steam s browser had started, because since 8.1 that browser runs inside mihawkos. it now notices: on the test console the phone and qr screen came up about 4½ minutes after steam s install, with steam s browser still inside mihawkos. thanks to portablelle for finding the cause and proposing the fix if you used the steam-browser-optout workaround from the issue, you can delete that folder known issues small leftovers in the new look: a faint grey no can show inside a message box s cancel button after it moves quick settings on tiles keep the default blue, and the task dialog s layout is still the old one a brief black frame when mihawkos switches between big picture and the game big picture can still hitch now and then while pages load not fixed yet on the controller: camera drift, the create button, the touchpad as a mouse, the steam input cursor and input lag. some games, such as the binding of isaac, can map the controller oddly restart the ps5 now and then. pipe memory runs out after very many program starts; mihawkos says restart the ps5 when that happens the per-boot setup is yours: your payloads after every cold boot. never use rest mode with payloads loaded not supported: drm such as denuvo, and anti-cheat such as easy anti-cheat or battleye everything else from alpha 8.1 and alpha 8 still applies installing or updating ps5 mihawkos-v8.2.0-alpha-8.zip size: 565.0 mb; what it is: the mihawkos title: the ppsa99170 folder, windows runtime included ps5 mihawkos-v8.2.0-alpha-8.zip.sha256 size: 1 kb; what it is: the sha-256 of the zip ps5 mihawkos-v8.2.0-alpha-8-readme.txt size: 1 kb; what it is: the install steps in short ps5 mihawkos-v8.2.0-alpha-8-sha256sums size: 43 kb; what it is: the sha-256 of every file in the folder: sha256sum -c checks a copy mihawkos-update.txt size: 1 kb; what it is: the signed description mihawkos s update check reads from alpha 8.1, alpha 8 or 7.1: open mihawkos from the home screen. it finds 8.2, downloads it, checks its signature and installs it when you restart it from alpha 7: replace the ppsa99170 folder in data homebrew with the new one and open mihawkos: it installs the new runtime by itself new install, or from alpha 6: follow alpha 7 s steps with this release s zip. back up your saves first when updating your setup, your games in c: games , steam and your settings are kept no games, saves, keys or firmware are supplied. use only games and programs you have the 437885147.body: fixed fully installed games no longer ask you to continue the download or to clear space on your storage marvel s wolverine 29 boots again fewer hangs and black screens in games that open many packed files at once ghost of yotei 22 and other games that read files in the background through the system can now read packed files hollow knight silksong 15 no longer stops at launch on a folder install on the internal ssd debug build the black box data ampr emu trace.txt now also lists each file api a game used on packed files, once, even when the call succeeded 18 , so a game that dies before :9090 answers still leaves that list behind fixed a race when several threads logged a file event at the same time thanks a huge thank you to jamesst20, who did most of this release: the wolverine fix 20 , the packed read and packed-file number fixes 23 and the debug log race 24 , each found and tested on their own console they also tracked the spider-man 2 text problem down to the console language 31 welcome to everyone who reported a game for the first time anas-naam-allah 18 , soulseeker1996 21 , kptnfrakass 22 shahbbbj 25 , betelopson 26, 27, 28, 33 majimagorosandesu 29 , bikram1996 30 and vov4k957 31 thanks again to rgdevz 19 and ozankabulut 32 , and to auros222 and iammrman for testing builds in the comments reporting a game issues have a game report form. please share how your games run, both the ones that fail and the ones that work how to use copy libsceampr.sprx into the game s fakelib and mount the game with shadowmountplus disable fakelib update in settings zstd and lz4 packs can be made by ps5-dump-forge
